parameters.query:
SELECT
    transaction_date,
    merchant,
    amount,
    transaction_type,
    category,
    subcategory
FROM transactions
WHERE user_name = '{{ $json.body.user_name }}'
  AND transaction_date >= '{{ $json.body.month }}-01'
  AND transaction_date < DATE_ADD('{{ $json.body.month }}-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
ORDER BY transaction_date;
